start.card:
Two hospitals: a small one with 15 babies born a day, and a big one with 45.
Some days, over 60% of the babies born are boys. Which hospital has more of those days in a year?
start.title: Big hospital, small hospital

afterGuess.card: Let's test it. Press the button to run one whole year of births, 365 days, in both hospitals.
afterGuess.title: Big hospital, small hospital

after.card:
Small hospital: 25 days. Big hospital: 0 days.
Takeaway: a small hospital has more extreme days, even though a boy is equally likely everywhere. Try other sizes, or run more years.
after.title: Big hospital, small hospital
